title: gate add --do accepts an option whose text holds '=', such as a tests-ceiling answer
goal: Found at the SP-m3azo2y7 close: gate add on BG-b5vvixda refused --do 'tests-ceiling ids=100 ...=BG-b5vvixda' with 'OPTION one of the --option values', because --do splits OPTION=CMD at the first '=' and the tests-ceiling answer form (kb/_self/code.md) holds several; the gate was filed without its do entries. --do splits at the '=' after the longest --option value it starts with (or at the last '='), so every option of the documented answer forms can name its item.
